name: How do I choose the right size D-shaped handle for my cabinets?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size D-shaped handle for my cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Selecting the correct size D-shaped handle depends on the cabinet door or drawer dimensions. For standard cabinet doors (12-18 inches wide), handles between 3-5 inches (76-128mm) in length are common. For wider drawers or pantry doors, longer handles (6-12 inches or more) can be more proportionate and functional. Consider the 'center-to-center' measurement (distance between screw holes) as this is crucial for installation and matching existing holes if replacing handles.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose handle size based on cabinet door/drawer dimensions; standard doors often use 3-5 inch handles. Measure center-to-center for screw hole compatibility.
